speedrun: Locate the workspace, executable, documentation, fixtures, and build files.
Read the spool, manifest, bank CSV, canonicalization, audit-chain, report, and helper-protocol documentation.
Inspect the Makefile, configuration, and existing test or fixture-generation scripts.
Build and run the current reconciler on the supplied fixture; save its report and timing.
Compare the current report with the known-good report to identify stage-level discrepancies.
Trace the current executable to observe helper invocations, temporary files, and protocol framing.
Read the remaining helper transcripts and probe the helper with controlled manifests and rotation contexts.
Inspect the reconciler pipeline, framing code, JSON code, and state lifetime across batches.
Inspect the fixture generator to learn generated references, adjustments, rotations, and malformed-frame cases.
Map the existing data structures and identify where transaction identity, authentication, and adjustment state are lost.
Replace the frame reader with length-safe streaming logic that distinguishes clean EOF, truncation, and malformed lengths.
Preserve explicit byte lengths and binary plaintext, including zero bytes and UTF-8 metadata.
Implement the documented helper protocol with exact context, nonce, key, version, and endianness handling.
Reuse a persistent helper session rather than launching a process for each frame.
Verify authentication before decryption and before any state mutation; retain every rejection with its reason.
Index transactions and adjustments by the complete documented reference identity, not displayed transaction ID.
Apply signed adjustments exactly once while supporting reordered frames and duplicate displayed IDs.
Implement the documented integer parsing, canonical length-prefixed serialization, and stable audit-chain ordering.
Fix key-rotation state handling and reject frames bound to the wrong rotation.
Emit the complete deterministic JSON report with documented key ordering and integer monetary fields.
Rebuild and compare the supplied fixture report byte-for-byte with the reference.
Run generated boundary, reorder, duplicate-reference, UTF-8, zero-byte, negative-adjustment, mutation, and truncation cases.
Run the 100,000-frame benchmark while measuring elapsed time and additional resident memory; optimize remaining hot paths.
Repeat identical batches in separate processes, inspect failures, and perform a final clean rebuild and verification run.
invalid_failure_risks: The 2.50-second threshold may be flaky unless verification pins CPU allocation, background load, compiler behavior, and timing methodology.
'Additional resident memory' should define whether helper processes and shared pages are included and how the baseline is measured.
Tests would overreach if rejection-reason strings, malformed-frame identity, or key-rotation boundary semantics are not fully specified in the supplied documentation.
A pinned apt or pip version that is unavailable from the configured package sources would make the stated offline build environment invalid.
The verifier must define whether reports include rejected malformed frames that lack a usable reference and how those entries are canonically ordered.
review.reasons: The task has a clear end state, strong deterministic verification hooks, and realistic multi-stage cryptographic and reconciliation failure modes. It is difficult but solvable from the supplied documentation and tooling, although the combination of opaque-helper investigation, exact binary semantics, and a tight benchmark makes an under-an-hour solution demanding. The scores exceed the acceptance threshold.
fixes: Specify the exact benchmark CPU isolation, timing command, warm-up policy, and resident-memory accounting method.
State explicitly how malformed or truncated frames are represented in the JSON report when no reference can be decoded.
Include a machine-readable report schema or explicit canonical ordering rules for rejection entries and all JSON fields.
Pin the base image by digest and document an offline apt/pip cache or package mirror containing every pinned dependency.
Document the required helper-session lifecycle and key-rotation boundary semantics in one normative protocol section.

The shared finance and binary-processing context is superficial because this task repairs a cryptographic settlement reconciler, not a Monte Carlo deployment pipeline, accumulator, and SQLite ledger.
